about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in SEEING RED, a single-player, first-person survival horror experience that pulls you into a chilling narrative filled with suspense and mystery. You step into the shoes of Benjamin, an ex-military private detective whose troubled past comes back to haunt him when he returns to his forgotten childhood town.

SEEING RED is a full-featured first-person survival horror game that offers an intense and immersive experience. This product includes:

  • Full Story Campaign – A gripping, atmospheric narrative following your search for your missing sister, uncovering dark secrets along the way.

Gameplay Features:

  • First-Person Combat – Use firearms and melee weapons to fight off relentless monsters, but beware—ammo and stamina are limited.

  • Stealth & Evasion – Hide, run, or find alternative ways to survive against creatures hunting you.

  • Investigation & Exploration – Search for clues, interact with NPCs, and uncover the town’s dark secrets through dialogue and environmental storytelling.

  • Decision-Making – Your choices affect how the story unfolds, leading to different outcomes and interactions.

  • Puzzles & Lore Discovery – Solve cryptic puzzles, piece together hidden lore, and unveil the truth behind the horrors that surround you.

  • Immersive Horror Experience – Photorealistic visuals, dynamic sound design, and psychological horror elements that heighten tension and fear.

content_descriptors.notes:
This is a survival horror game were you will face horrific creatures that are attacking you. 
There is blood splatter, guns, alcohol, bleak and scary locations.
